purpose: Public governance contract for keeping Moral Trade decisioning deterministic, schema-bound, documented, and human-controlled before any ML-assisted ranking or scoring is introduced.

requiredDocumentationBeforeMl.label: Model card
requiredDocumentationBeforeMl.rule: Any model used beyond rendering deterministic factor codes must publish intended use, non-use, risk, performance slices, and failure modes.

requiredDocumentationBeforeMl.label: Dataset datasheet
requiredDocumentationBeforeMl.rule: Any historical training or evaluation dataset must document collection, consent, composition, retention, exclusion rules, and known limitations.

requiredDocumentationBeforeMl.label: Benchmark slices
requiredDocumentationBeforeMl.rule: Benchmarks must include cause-area, trade-format, geography, privacy-stage, and optional governed sensitive-attribute slices.

requiredDocumentationBeforeMl.label: Intended-use limits
requiredDocumentationBeforeMl.rule: Documentation must state that the model cannot rank global moral value, make safety decisions, disclose counterparties, or complete agreements.

requiredDocumentationBeforeMl.label: Fairness audit report
requiredDocumentationBeforeMl.rule: Before rollout, publish aggregate fairness metrics, trade-offs, reviewed deviations, and remediation decisions.

requiredDocumentationBeforeMl.label: Change log
requiredDocumentationBeforeMl.rule: Every material model, dataset, prompt, or metric change must have an operator-visible change log entry and rollback note.

documentationTemplates.label: Model card template
documentationTemplates.reviewRule: A reviewer must confirm intended use, non-use, performance slices, known risks, and rollback before any model leaves shadow mode.

documentationTemplates.label: Dataset datasheet template
documentationTemplates.reviewRule: A reviewer must confirm consent, exclusions, retention, redaction, and correction paths before any dataset supports training or evaluation.

documentationTemplates.label: Benchmark-slice template
documentationTemplates.reviewRule: A reviewer must confirm benchmark slices are privacy-thresholded and include the documented trade-format, cause-area, geography, and privacy-stage cuts.

documentationTemplates.label: Intended-use limits template
documentationTemplates.reviewRule: A reviewer must confirm the documented use limit forbids global moral ranking, safety blocking, disclosure, and completion decisions.

documentationTemplates.label: Fairness audit report template
documentationTemplates.reviewRule: A reviewer must log material slice gaps, trade-offs, remediation, and a promotion decision before any ML-assisted ranking or scoring scales.

documentationTemplates.label: Change-log template
documentationTemplates.reviewRule: A reviewer or operator must approve material model, dataset, prompt, metric, or template changes before promotion and keep a rollback note.

fields.intended_use: Render reviewer-facing summaries from deterministic factor codes in shadow mode.
fields.decision_boundaries: Cannot publish, match, disclose, complete, dispute, or mutate proposal state.
fields.training_data_summary: No raw private wishes, source notes, contact details, or private feeds are used.
fields.rollback_plan: Disable assisted rendering and fall back to deterministic/manual review.

publicSummary.intended_use: Render reviewer-facing summaries from deterministic factor codes in shadow mode.

fields.collection_purpose: Evaluate whether deterministic factor-code summaries remain faithful to reviewed fields.
fields.consent_basis: Only synthetic worked examples and consented, redacted metadata may be used.
fields.composition_summary: Small pilot slices by trade format, cause-area pair, and privacy stage.
fields.retention_policy: Aggregate summaries only; raw private text is not retained for ML evaluation.
fields.known_limitations: Pilot-scale samples are not representative of production liquidity.
fields.sensitive_attribute_handling: Optional governed attributes require separate review and small-cell suppression.
fields.deletion_or_correction_path: Participant data-right requests remove or correct any consented row before future evaluation.

publicSummary.collection_purpose: Evaluate whether deterministic factor-code summaries remain faithful to reviewed fields.
publicSummary.composition_summary: Small pilot slices by trade format, cause-area pair, and privacy stage.
publicSummary.retention_policy: Aggregate summaries only; raw private text is not retained for ML evaluation.
publicSummary.known_limitations: Pilot-scale samples are not representative of production liquidity.

fields.sample_count: 8 worked examples; no production readiness claim.
fields.confidence_notes: Insufficient live sample size; use only for validator shape and redaction checks.

publicSummary.sample_count: 8 worked examples; no production readiness claim.

fields.human_review_boundary: All reliance, disclosure, completion, and dispute outcomes require human control.
fields.state_mutation_boundary: AI output cannot directly write proposal status or agreement completion.
fields.disclosure_boundary: Exact wishes, contacts, and counterparties remain consent-gated.
fields.appeal_or_override_path: Participants and reviewers can challenge the specific claim, evidence row, disclosure decision, or policy flag.

publicSummary.human_review_boundary: All reliance, disclosure, completion, and dispute outcomes require human control.
publicSummary.state_mutation_boundary: AI output cannot directly write proposal status or agreement completion.

fields.thresholds: Material slice gaps require review before promotion.
fields.observed_deviations: No live ML deployment; sample is validator-only.
fields.reviewed_tradeoffs: Fairness metrics may conflict and must be documented before rollout.
fields.remediation_plan: Keep ML in shadow mode until deviations are reviewed and remediated.
fields.promotion_decision: Blocked for live ranking or matching; shadow documentation only.

publicSummary.thresholds: Material slice gaps require review before promotion.
publicSummary.observed_deviations: No live ML deployment; sample is validator-only.
publicSummary.remediation_plan: Keep ML in shadow mode until deviations are reviewed and remediated.
publicSummary.promotion_decision: Blocked for live ranking or matching; shadow documentation only.

fields.reason_for_change: Make model-card, datasheet, benchmark, fairness, limits, and change-log requirements executable.
fields.risk_assessment: No ML behavior enabled; validates public documentation shape only.
fields.rollback_note: Remove sample packet promotion and retain deterministic/manual fallback.

publicSummary.reason_for_change: Make model-card, datasheet, benchmark, fairness, limits, and change-log requirements executable.
publicSummary.risk_assessment: No ML behavior enabled; validates public documentation shape only.
publicSummary.rollback_note: Remove sample packet promotion and retain deterministic/manual fallback.

permittedAutomation.label: Schema-bound drafting
permittedAutomation.rule: Drafting may normalize user text into approved proposal fields without inventing facts or evidence.

permittedAutomation.label: Missing-field detection
permittedAutomation.rule: Automation may flag missing required fields and ask clarification questions tied to those fields.

permittedAutomation.label: Factor-code explanation rendering
permittedAutomation.rule: Automation may render explanations only from deterministic factor codes and approved redaction rules.

permittedAutomation.label: Evidence checklist drafting
permittedAutomation.rule: Automation may draft checklists of observable artifacts without deciding that evidence is sufficient.

permittedAutomation.label: Reviewer-summary drafting
permittedAutomation.rule: Automation may summarize records for reviewers while preserving uncertainty and unresolved flags.

prohibitedUses.label: End-to-end LLM matching
prohibitedUses.rule: No model may decide counterparties or matchability from broad application context.

prohibitedUses.label: Global moral ranking
prohibitedUses.rule: No model or optimization layer may claim a platform-wide objective moral ranking.

prohibitedUses.label: Unreviewed learning to rank
prohibitedUses.rule: Historical outcome ranking cannot be used until labels, bias risks, model cards, and fairness audits are complete.

prohibitedUses.label: Protected-trait inference
prohibitedUses.rule: Models must not infer protected traits, ideology, psychology, or hidden preferences for matching.

prohibitedUses.label: Autonomous outreach
prohibitedUses.rule: No automation may contact or reveal counterparties without explicit consent and human-controlled disclosure.

prohibitedUses.label: Raw private-feed training
prohibitedUses.rule: Raw private wishes, source notes, contact details, and private feeds cannot be used as model training input.

fairnessDocumentation.reviewRule: Material slice gaps must be thresholded, reviewed, documented, and remediated before promotion.

explanationControls.label: Factor codes are the source of truth
explanationControls.rule: Natural-language explanations may render deterministic factor codes and cited fields, but must not become a separate reasoning source.

explanationControls.label: Meaningful user action
explanationControls.rule: Every explanation must state the current status, why the deterministic factors led there, and what action the participant or reviewer can take next.

explanationControls.label: System accuracy boundary
explanationControls.rule: Explanations must be accurate to the system inputs: source fields, factor codes, evidence rows, and policy flags, without claiming hidden context or objective moral truth.

explanationControls.label: Uncertainty and redaction notice
explanationControls.rule: Explanations must name uncertainty flags and redacted surfaces when private wishes, contact details, sensitive constraints, or evidence remain hidden.

explanationControls.label: Appealable review scope
explanationControls.rule: Reviewer-facing explanations must state which claim, evidence row, or policy flag can be appealed and which unrelated moral disagreements are out of scope.

explanationControls.label: Reversible interaction
explanationControls.rule: Explanations must support correction, resubmission, or human override before state changes; users can correct fields without automatic disclosure or reliance.

explanationControls.label: Local explanation methods are gated
explanationControls.rule: LIME, SHAP, or similar local feature-attribution explanations are inactive unless actual ML ranking or risk scoring is introduced with model governance, fairness audits, and reviewer-only diagnostics.

externalStandards.label: NIST AI RMF
externalStandards.use: Govern, map, measure, and manage any model-assisted workflow before rollout.

externalStandards.label: NIST XAI principles
externalStandards.use: Require explanations that are meaningful, accurate to the system, bounded, and uncertainty-aware.

externalStandards.label: Model Cards
externalStandards.use: Document model purpose, limits, performance, risks, and non-use cases.

externalStandards.label: Datasheets for Datasets
externalStandards.use: Document dataset collection, consent, composition, retention, and limitations.

externalStandards.label: Fairness trade-off literature
externalStandards.use: Avoid pretending one fairness metric is universally correct; publish trade-offs and review decisions.

externalStandards.label: LIME and SHAP diagnostics
externalStandards.use: Use only as governed internal diagnostics if model-based ranking or risk scoring is introduced; do not present feature attribution as deterministic Moral Trade reasoning.
